concerns.text: The plan cites 'GFM Weights (EuroSAT)' and 'GFM Weights (DFC2020)' from Hugging Face as sources for the Geometric Foundation Model. EuroSAT and DFC2020 are satellite imagery datasets (2D RGB), whereas the project requires a 3D latent geometric model for robot policy learning (GAM). These datasets are semantically inappropriate for the required modality (3D geometry vs. 2D satellite imagery). The plan must cite a dataset or repository containing the actual pre-trained GAM/GFM weights for 3D manipulation tasks, not a placeholder satellite image dataset.

The plan states: 'Reference Statistics: Computed locally by loading a sample of the original GAM training data (if accessible)...'. The plan fails to cite the source for this 'original GAM training data'. Without a verified URL or repository reference for the training set used to compute the latent mean/covariance, the drift detection mechanism (Constitution VI) cannot be reproduced or validated. The plan must cite the specific dataset or repository containing the original GAM training distribution.
